script.thesis: Perseverance in love is not about grand gestures but the small, unglamorous act of continuing to show up, even when the bed feels empty.
script.monologue: You think you're done. The fight was louder than anything you've said in years. You wake at dawn, bracing for silence. But the kettle clicks on, just before you ask. You don't have to believe in forever. You leave the kettle sitting cold. You just have to start.
